The submission meets the criterion. The LangGraph changes are limited to adding optional schema support:

- `interrupt(value)` remains valid and returns `Any` when no schema is supplied. Without a schema, no `TypeAdapter` is created and resume values are returned without validation or conversion.
- `response_schema` is keyword-only and defaults to `None` in `interrupt`, `Interrupt.__init__`, and `Interrupt.from_ns`, preserving existing call patterns.
- `Interrupt`’s generic parameter defaults to `Any`, so existing unparameterized type annotations remain supported.
- The SDK adds `response_schema` as `NotRequired[dict[str, Any]]`, so existing interrupt dictionaries containing only the previous fields remain valid.

The provider changes are narrowly scoped and do not require existing callers or SDK consumers to supply the new field.
